replacements.text: Strongest feature: Flew distinguishes authority that an experience occurred from authority that its object exists, using the cow comparison to expose the inference from phenomenology to veridical divine encounter. Principal limitation: This evidence restricts testimony as public proof but neither demonstrates unreliability nor identifies defeaters sufficient to withhold personal warrant extended to perception. Live burden: Flew must articulate reliability criteria and defeaters, while Craig must supply discriminators separating divine contact from hallucination, projection, or incompatible revelation and explain why immediacy bridges the evidential gap. Locked score: The exact 84 follows from logical coherence 86, evidence warrant 75, responsiveness 90, relevance and burden 84, precision and clarity 85, and calibration and charity 84, recognizing a direct, delimited distinction whose evidential support leaves personal justification unresolved.
Flew argues cosmic probabilities have neither known propensities nor a frequency class of other universes, so Craig has not warranted fine-tuning’s numerical chance premise.
